name: tet methylcytosine dioxygenase 2

function.text: TET2 encodes an enzyme that oxidizes methylated cytosine in DNA, contributing to DNA-demethylation pathways and regulation of hematopoietic differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to immunodeficiency 75 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include MDS/MPN, NOS; Systemic mastocytosis; Myelodysplastic neoplasm. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
